description: Defines classes and templates for handling text stream termination and processing, including different terminator types and a templated stream text handler with queue management and data transmission logic.

classes.name: StreamTextType
classes.description: Template class for managing text streams with terminators, including queue management, data sending/receiving, and state handling.

methods.name: IsTerminated
methods.description: Determines if a character signifies termination based on terminator type.

methods.name: SizeOf
methods.description: Returns the size of the terminator sequence.

methods.name: Marker
methods.description: Returns the terminator sequence as a string.

methods.name: SendData
methods.description: Sends queued text data over the connection.

methods.name: ReceiveData
methods.description: Processes received data, detects terminators, and triggers callbacks.
